language_unreviewed: Akekho okhuluma lolu limi njengolimi lwebele osehlole lokhu kuhumusha.
login_unreachable: Ayikwazi ukufinyelela ku-Ottie. Ingabe i-“ottie serve” iyasebenza?
login_hint: Noma qalisa i-“ottie open” ukuze uvule leli khasi usungene ngemvume.
add_automatic_hint: Kukhethwe ngohlobo lwefayela. Igama langempela lefayela kuseva lisengakushintsha.
add_folder_hint: Kukhethwe ngefolda: ifolda yesigaba iyibeka kuleso sigaba, noma iyiphi enye ifolda ku-{other}.
add_streaming_hint: Kufika ngokulandelana, ukuphela kwefayela kuqala, ukuze kudlale kusalandwa.
empty: Akukho lutho okwamanje. Namathisela isixhumanisi ngenhla ukuze ugcine ifayela.
remove_confirm: Susa u-“{name}” bese usula okulandiwe kuze kube manje?
cancel_confirm: Khansela u-“{name}” bese usula okulandiwe kuze kube manje?
status_waiting_retry: Ilinde indawo evulekile ukuze izame futhi
det_no_bandwidth: Akukho okwamanje: umkhawulo wesivinini uya kokunye ukulanda (okuphuthumayo kuqala)
problem_stalled: Ayikho idatha evela kuseva isikhathi esingu-{time}
reason_unsupported_scheme: Kusekelwa izixhumanisi ze-http ne-https kuphela (hhayi i-{scheme}).
cancel_confirm_many: Khansela ukulanda okungu-{count} bese usula okulandiwe kuze kube manje?
remove_confirm_many: Susa ukulanda okungu-{count} bese usula okulandiwe kwalokho okungaqediwe?
dash_speed_over: Isivinini sokulanda sisonke esikhathini esingu-{time} esedlule: {now} manje, {peak} okuphezulu.
cat_intro: Ukulanda kuya esigabeni esibala isandiso sefayela lakho, futhi kugcinwa efolda yaleso sigaba. Okunye konke kuya kokuthi Okuvamile.
cat_no_folder: Ayikho ifolda: ukulanda ngakunye kumele kuqambe eyodwa
cat_no_extensions: Azikho izandiso: ukulanda okubeka lapha kuphela
cat_remove_confirm: Susa isigaba esithi “{name}”? Ukulanda kwaso kuya kokuthi Okuvamile; amafayela akho ahlala lapho ekhona.
cat_extensions_hint: Zihlukaniswe ngamakhefu noma izikhala, isb. mp4, mkv, webm
setup_intro: I-Ottie ihlela ukulanda ngezigaba ngohlobo lwefayela, ngasinye sinefolda yaso. Gcina lezo ozifunayo; ungazishintsha kamuva ekhasini lezigaba.
setup_folder_hint: Amafayela angangeni kunoma yisiphi isigaba aya lapha, kokuthi Okuvamile.
setup_startup_hint: Ungakushintsha lokhu kamuva ku-Izilungiselelo → Uhlelo lwekhompyutha.
set_appearance_hint: Ukubukeka nolimi kugcinwa kule divayisi kuphela.
set_palette_sea_hint: Igwebu lolwandle emini, Ichibi lasogwini ebusuku
set_language_hint: Futhi nakulokho i-daemon ekubikayo, njengokuthi kungani ukulanda kwehlulekile.
queue_drag: Hudula ukuze uhambise u-{name} kulayini (noma usebenzise okhiye bemicibisholo)
cat_try_placeholder: Namathisela isixhumanisi ukuze ubone isigaba saso
set_sync_hint: Ukubukeka nolimi kuyafana kuyo yonke idivayisi lapho lokhu kuvuliwe.
set_max_concurrent_hint: Okunye kulinda kulayini. Ukusehlisa akukaze kumise ukulanda okuqhubekayo.
set_stream_media_hint: Ukulanda okusha kwamavidiyo nomculo kufika ngokulandelana, ukuphela kwefayela kuqala, ukuze kudlale kusalandwa. Ukulanda ngakunye kusengakushintsha.
limit_total_hint: Kwabelwana ngakho phakathi kokulanda okuqhubekayo ngokubaluleka. Futhi kubha yesihloko.
limit_chip_hint: Kwabelwana ngakho phakathi kokulanda okuqhubekayo ngokubaluleka.
set_retries_hint: Uma uxhumano lunqamuka noma iseva imatasa, i-Ottie izama futhi ngokwayo.
set_max_retries_hint: Ilandelana, ibalwa kusukela idatha ifika okokugcina. U-0 akaphinde azame.
set_first_wait_hint: Ukulinda ngakunye okulandelayo kuphindwe kabili, kuze kufike emzuzwini owodwa. Iseva ingacela isikhathi eside.
set_yield_hint: Ukulanda okuzama futhi kugcina indawo yakho izikhathi ezingaka, bese kuvumela okulindile kuqale.
set_link_hint: Sivula i-Ottie usungene ngemvume, kwesinye isiphequluli noma kwenye idivayisi. Noma ubani onaso angaphatha ukulanda kwakho.
set_play_system_hint: Noma yini evula uhlu lokudlala (.m3u) lapha. Ukuze kube yi-VLC, setha i-VLC njengohlelo oluzenzakalelayo lwamafayela e-.m3u ezilungiselelweni zesistimu yakho.
set_play_browser_hint: Kuthebhu entsha. Iziphequluli azikwazi ukudlala wonke amafayela, ikakhulukazi i-MKV
set_app_hint: Indlela uhlelo oluziphatha ngayo kule khompyutha
set_close_to_tray_hint: Ukuvala iwindi kuyalifihla, futhi ukulanda kuyaqhubeka. Ukuze uphume, sebenzisa imenyu yesithonjana se-Ottie kuthreyi.
set_startup_tray_hint: Ukulanda okungaqediwe kuyaqhubeka, nesithonjana sethreyi nezaziso
set_startup_daemon_hint: Kuyaqhubeka kungekho lutho esikrinini: asikho isithonjana sethreyi noma izaziso uze uvule i-Ottie, futhi ukuphuma ku-Ottie ngemva kwalokho kukushiya kuqhubeka
set_notifications_hint: Lokho uhlelo lwekhompyutha olukutshela khona kule khompyutha
set_notify_all_hint: Isaziso esisodwa uma kungasekho okulandwayo noma okulindile
set_notify_failed_hint: Ngemva komzamo wakho wokugcina, noma ngaso leso sikhathi uma ukuzama futhi kungeke kusize
set_sounds_hint: Isethi ngayinye inomsindo wokulanda okuqediwe nomunye wokwehlulekile
reason_out_of_range: {setting} kumele kube kusuka ku-{min} kuya ku-{max}.
reason_out_of_range_seconds: {setting} kumele kube kusuka kumasekhondi angu-{min} kuya ku-{max}.
fl_views_hint: Izindlela zokubuka ezilondoloziwe zivela njengezihlungi ezisheshayo
det_none_hint: Khetha ukulanda ukuze ubone imininingwane nezilungiselelo zakho lapha.
det_several_hint: Khetha okukodwa kuphela ukuze ubone imininingwane yakho.
det_play_hint: Kudlala esipheqululini sakho, ngisho nangaphambi kokuthi ukulanda kuqede
det_play_hint_app: Kudlala esidlalini esikhethwe ku-Izilungiselelo, ngisho nangaphambi kokuthi ukulanda kuqede
det_open_player_hint: Kulondoloza uhlu oluncane lokudlala (.m3u): luvule, futhi isidlali sesistimu yakho sidlala okulandwayo, ngisho nangaphambi kokuthi kuqede. Ukuze kube yi-VLC, yisethe njengohlelo oluzenzakalelayo lwamafayela e-.m3u.
det_copy_link_hint: Isixhumanisi se-VLC noma esinye isidlali, esisebenza kuze kube singasetshenziswa amahora angu-12. Noma ubani onaso angadlala leli fayela.
open_gone: U-“{name}” akasekho lapho: uhanjisiwe noma usuliwe.
det_limit_hint: Umkhawulo wakho. Imikhawulo iyonke neyesigaba isasebenza.
det_priority_hint: Okuphezulu kuthola okuningi komkhawulo wonke futhi kuqala ngokushesha. Okuphuthumayo kuqala kuqala.
det_streaming_hint: Ngokulandelana, ukuphela kwefayela kuqala, ukuze kudlale kusalandwa. Ngoxhumano olulodwa, kufika ngokulandelana noma kunjalo.
view_delete_confirm: Susa indlela yokubuka ethi “{name}”? Ukulanda kwakho kuhlala kunjalo.
reason_job_moving: Lokho kulanda kuyahanjiswa. Zama futhi uma sekuqediwe.
reason_cannot_move_while_running: Lokhu kulanda akukwazi ukuqhubeka kamuva, ngakho kungahambela kwenye ifolda kuphela uma sekuqediwe.
batch_text_placeholder: Namathisela izixhumanisi, esisodwa emugqeni ngamunye, noma noma yimuphi umbhalo oziqukethe: i-imeyili, ikhasi lewebhu…
batch_text_hint: Izixhumanisi ziqala nge-http:// noma nge-https://. Ngasinye silandwa sodwa. Uchungechunge olunezinombolo lungena esixhumanisini esisodwa: [001-120], [a-z], [0-100:10], \{small,large\}.
batch_some_refused: Ukulanda okungeziwe: {count}. Izixhumanisi ezisele azikwazanga ukwengezwa; ngasinye sisho isizathu.
reason_too_many_links: Lezo yizixhumanisi ezingu-{count} ngesikhathi esisodwa; okuningi kakhulu ngu-{max} (Izilungiselelo, Ukulanda).
set_max_batch_hint: Uma wengeza izixhumanisi eziningana ngesikhathi esisodwa. Uma zeqile, zonke ziyenqatshwa.
det_schedule_hint: Akunalutho: kuqala ngokushesha okukhulu, futhi akumi ngokwakho. Ukulanda okuqhubekayo okunikezwe isikhathi sokuqala kuyama kuze kufike leso sikhathi.
add_when_hint: Akunalutho: kuqala manje, futhi akumi ngokwakho.
reason_stop_before_start: Isikhathi sokuma kumele size ngemva kwesikhathi sokuqala.
slot_bad_max: Kungaki ngesikhathi esisodwa: kusuka ku-{min} kuya ku-{max}.
slot_need_limit: Vula umkhawulo wesivinini noma isibalo ngesikhathi esisodwa.
reason_slot_without_effect: Khetha ukuthi isikhathi senzani: ukuvumela noma ukumisa ukulanda, noma ukusetha umkhawulo.
reason_invalid_slot_order: Izikhathi ezibekiwe zishintshile phakathi nalokho; zama futhi.
sched_intro: Izikhathi ezibekiwe zisho ukuthi ukulanda kuqhubeka nini, kuyama nini noma kuhamba kancane nini, kukho konke noma esigabeni esisodwa. Uma ezimbili zisebenza ngesikhathi esisodwa, esiphezulu ohlwini siyawina.
sched_week_hint: Hudula isikhathi ukuze usihambise, noma unqenqema lwaso olungaphezulu noma olungezansi ukuze ushintshe ukuthi siqala nini noma siphela nini. Chofoza kuso ukuze usihlele.
sched_empty: Azikho izikhathi ezibekiwe okwamanje: ukulanda kuqhubeka noma nini lapho kungakwazi khona.
sched_editor_overlaps: Kugqagqana no-{names}. Uma ezimbili zisetha into efanayo ngokuhlukile, esiphezulu ohlwini siyawina.
sched_hours_hint: Ukuphela ngaphambi kokuqala kudlulela osukwini olulandelayo; isikhathi esifanayo kabili wusuku lonke.
sched_leave_hint: Kushintsha isivinini noma ukuthi kungaki okuqhubekayo ngesikhathi esisodwa; akukaze kuqale noma kumise ukulanda.
sched_allow_hint: Ukulanda kuyaqhubeka, ngisho nalapho isikhathi esingezansi ohlwini sikumisa. Imikhawulo ayiphoqelekile.
sched_stay_paused_hint: Ukulanda esakubamba kuhlala kumisiwe uze ukuqhubekise. Ukuvala isikhathi noma ukusisusa kukuvumela kuqhubeke.
sched_limit_hint: Sisonke kulokho esisebenza kukho. Akunalutho: awukho umkhawulo ngesikhathi sisaqhubeka.
finish_cant_hibernate: Ukulala isikhathi eside kuvaliwe kule khompyutha
finish_once_hint: Kulokhu kuphela. Izilungiselelo zikhetha zonke izikhathi.
finish_failed: Akukwazanga ukushintsha okwenzekayo uma konke sekuqediwe.
set_finish_hint: Njalo uma okulandiwe kuqeda. Imenyu ye-Ottie nekhasi le-Okulandiwe kungakhetha okunye kanye.
set_countdown_hint: Isikhathi sokukhansela ngaphambi kokuthi ikhompyutha ilale, ilale isikhathi eside noma ivaleke
set_countdown_notification_hint: Kukhansele kumenyu ye-Ottie noma ekhasini le-Okulandiwe
set_finish_waits_hint: Kuvaliwe: kuqediwe uma kungasekho okufanele kusebenze manje
caught_failed: U-Ottie akakwazi ukufunda lezi zixhumanisi manje.
set_watch_clipboard_hint: Izixhumanisi eziya ezinhlotsheni zamafayela ezibalwe yizigaba zakho kuphela. Hhayi lokho okukopisha ku-Ottie, noma lokho umphathi wamaphasiwedi akumaka njengokuyimfihlo.
set_copied_ask_hint: Iwindi elincane ekhoneni lesikrini liyakunikeza ngaphandle kokukuphazamisa
setup_clipboard_hint: U-Ottie unikeza izixhumanisi zokulanda ozikopisha kwezinye izinhlelo. Ungakushintsha lokhu kamuva ku-Izilungiselelo → Ibhodi lokunamathisela.
set_keyboard_hint: Cindezela u-? kunoma yiliphi ikhasi ukuze uzibone.
